title: Anonymous role reads a locked table by executing a SECURITY DEFINER function

expect.note: the body runs as c_definer_fn_owner, who owns `secrets`, so corpus_anon reads every row through EXECUTE alone — a privilege no ACL entry on the table confers on it
RLS is not FORCEd, which is why the owner's read inside the body is not filtered by the table's own policy

fix: Narrow the body to what the function is meant to expose, authorize the caller inside it, or give the function an owner whose reach matches its job — and make it SECURITY INVOKER if the hand-off of c_definer_fn_owner's privileges was not intended. Revoking EXECUTE is not the fix: that grant is what the API serves.
